title: Sabzevar expedition
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Sabzevar expedition", at revision 1378917303, opens: "The Sabzevar expedition was a politically decisive event in Nader's career where he in effect turned from mere commander-in-chief of Tahmasp II's forces into the real power behind the throne. The expedition was launched mainly due to Tahmasp's own incompetence and ill-thought attempt at curbing the powers of his upstart general and military genius." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q18209946, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "part of Nader's campaigns (1727–28)". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
